Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear index. A few notes:

- A SIG mapping one-pager would be very helpful; please map the artifacts to SIG control IDs and note which artifacts are partial (redacted) vs full.
- Hashed IDs are acceptable for now; if we need unhashed identifiers for our triage, we'll request a joint-handling session with ForenSec and provide a legal access statement.

Please proceed with SFTP delivery for the full logs. Can your team confirm the fingerprint and user account we'll connect to? Also, schedule the 30-minute walkthrough at 10:00 AM PST tomorrow (3/26) or let us know alternative slots.
